title.en: Open adaptive loops, assume-guarantee joint viability, the coupled race, and adaptive collapse

statement.en: Open adaptive agents compose as black boxes over coupled substrates when warning margin exceeds draw times alarm lag; when discovery, pool silence, post-turn drawers, and lag compete, viability turns on their race; unread adapting loops collapse jointly while bidirectional adaptation holds.

laws.en: Open adaptive loop interface and opaque assume-guarantee composition: OpenLoop processes disturbances under state-independent admissibility (Viability.disturbed), carrying observation-triggered alarms (emitAlarm), silence loads, pre-countdown/post-countdown draw bounds, and bounded countdown lag eta ≤ maxLag inside LoopCertificate. Under pooled site monitoring, an observation-driven channel blind to raw substrate stock st.1, monotone rising coupled dynamics (Coupled.Indexed.Rises Drawn.whole), post-turn threshold viability, and warning buffer x_crit + (globalMaxLag + 1) * preTotal ≤ warnLevel plus initial buffer x_crit + maxEta init * preTotal ≤ x_0, assume_guarantee_joint_viable proves joint Viability.Certificate (and assume_guarantee_joint_kernel proves Viability.Kernel) without unfolding (L i).next or (certs i).K.

Coupled Race Theorem: inside raceStep, alarm gating directly evaluates five-member pool majority (SelectionPool.Web.holdsCount / MajorityHolds, silenced at K_silence ≤ loss by SelectionPool.Web.majority_outvoted) and post-turn drawdown embeds two-drawer coordination on CoupledDrawers.Optimum.Coupled.AtOnce.Shores.shore 1 (H_coord = 1 ≤ 1 vs any Perfect uncoordinated profile H_uncoord = 2 via Shores.drain_perfect). Across identical start stock 13 and critical floor 5, WitnessGood survives from step 4 onward, while WitnessNoDiscovery (probeAt = none), WitnessSilenced (probeAt = some 2 after watcher loss reaches 2), WitnessUncoordinated (post-turn drain = 2), and WitnessTooSlow (ruleLag = 2) each collapse to 0.

Joint collapse of unread adapting loops: under monotone substrate giving gSub and unread local shares (ClosedCapture.unread_course), when combined rule-dependent draws exceed H_joint while solo draws stay within solo viability, unread_adaptive_joint_collapse transfers RegimeMargin failure onto the joint substrate. UnreadAdaptiveCollapse.witness constructs two loops whose rules genuinely flip true ↔ false every step (draw 2 vs 3): each survives solo at stock 6, jointly crashes to 0 within 7 steps, and exhibits identical local shares, rule flips, and LocalOK to a high-stock 100 run.

Endogenous composite witness: concrete two-agent ReadingLoop.Loop.keep + PoolFromCourse.windowRead + Mechanism.adaptive system over Unit sharing one LoopCertificate. assume_guarantee_joint_viable certifies Viability.Kernel from both favours and restrained initial states, and endog_bidirectional_adaptation proves one admissible run transitions ¬ favours → favours (while x ≥ 16) and back favours → ¬ favours (once x drops below warnLevel 16) while permanently keeping 6 ≤ x.

hypotheses.en: No axiom. For assume_guarantee_joint_viable: finite lists sites and agents, full site coverage, state-independent admissibility on OpenLoop.process, blind channel firing within maxSilence, monotone Coupled.Indexed.Rises Drawn.whole dynamics, post-turn threshold viability at x_crit, and warning buffer x_crit + (globalMaxLag + 1) * preTotal ≤ warnLevel plus initial slack x_crit + maxEta init * preTotal ≤ x_0.
For unread_adaptive_joint_collapse: monotone substrate giving gSub, unread local shares, and joint draw floor H_joint ≤ jointDraw.

does_not_show.en: That real-world AI training, evaluation, or multi-agent deployment loops meet LoopCertificate lag bounds, monotone Coupled.Indexed dynamics, or deterministic Nat resource arithmetic without empirical calibration.
Optimality or performance within the safe region: assume_guarantee_joint_viable certifies invariant safety above x_crit, not capability maximization.
Stochastic or continuous-time slack bounds (those remain out of the prelude-only discrete Nat core).

next_delta.en: Couple observation-driven adaptive loops across coarse rule cadences and macro scales (Milestones 1A and 1C) and empirically stress-test the buffer bounds on noisy/generalizing learners (Phase 2).

correspondence.en: Reading (AI-written): compositional safety for coupled adaptive systems fails if any of four links breaks — untested-action discovery, watcher pool silence, post-turn drawer coordination, or adaptation lag exceeding the buffer between warning threshold and point of no return.
